data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is delighted to present this exceptional duplex 1-bedroom apartment for rent in SLS Dubai Hotel & Residences, Business Bay.

This stylish duplex residence offers a unique layout, contemporary design, and premium finishes throughout. With spacious interiors and floor-to-ceiling windows, the apartment provides a bright and sophisticated living environment in one of Dubai’s most prestigious addresses.

The apartment is fitted with bespoke European-made fixtures and fittings, including Franke kitchen sinks, Villeroy & Boch sanitary ware, and premium Gessi bathroom fittings. The fully fitted kitchen comes equipped with high-end Electrolux appliances, including a dishwasher, double-door refrigerator with freezer, electric hob, oven, washing machine, and dryer. Italian porcelain ceramic flooring by Lea adds a touch of elegance and refinement to the interiors.

Residents of SLS Dubai Hotel & Residences enjoy a prime Business Bay location with convenient access to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, DIFC, and major road networks, offering a perfect blend of luxury, convenience, and urban living.
